title: Single Article Readiness Contract
purpose: Collapse the existing upstream Article production prerequisites into one fail-closed machine-readable readiness result without changing or bypassing any upstream authority.

authoritySources.articleIntentAndHumanProductionDecision: existing Human Production Authority / VAP-W6A successor-readable evidence
authoritySources.productionPlanAndWave: existing frozen KPP/VAP production planning authority
authoritySources.publicationGuard: Publication Runtime plus existing portfolio publication evidence

consumerContract.APS-3: Batch selection consumes ARTICLE_READY and blockers only. APS-3 must not duplicate C2/C3/KPP/VAP gate interpretation.
consumerContract.futureCandidateOrchestration: May consume selected nodes only after APS-3 selection; candidate material remains non-authoritative.
consumerContract.futurePublication: Must still require explicit Human Publication Decision.
